## Services

- Conversion-focused business websites
- AI receptionists and website assistants
- CRM pipelines and appointment booking
- Email and SMS follow-up automation
- Reporting and custom business automation

## How the system works

A typical Adintecho workflow captures an inquiry from a website, phone call, or form; records the contact in a CRM; qualifies the opportunity; offers an available appointment; and triggers the appropriate email or SMS follow-up. Exact workflows and integrations are confirmed during discovery.

## Common use cases

- Capture missed or after-hours calls with an AI receptionist
- Qualify website and phone inquiries before staff follow-up
- Store contacts and opportunities in a managed CRM pipeline
- Offer available appointment times and send confirmations
- Trigger email and SMS follow-up after a form, call, or booking
- Give business owners a clearer view of lead and appointment activity

Plans are prepaid monthly. SMS features may require a one-time $70 10DLC registration fee. Current inclusions and terms should always be confirmed at https://adintecho.com/#plans and https://adintecho.com/#terms.
